entries.4739f42394837552: The medium-term management plan (ＦＹ2024～ＦＹ2026) sets out strengthening the competitiveness of the winding machine business and its approach in key regions centered on North America and China, with a particular focus on technology development to strengthen the competitiveness of ｘＥＶ drive motor and generator winding systems and brushless motor winding systems. For the blower business, it sets out raising added value through differentiation of axial-flow fans.
entries.51f8d3538bce7872: This business develops, designs and manufactures winding equipment for motors and winding equipment for coils according to customers' requests, and sells them in countries around the world. Sales to external customers in the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥13,583 million, accounting for approximately 3/4 of consolidated sales. It is carried out by the company, Odawara Automation Nagaoka Co., Ltd., Odawara Automation Inc. of the United States, Odawara Automation Deutschland GmbH of Germany and Odawara Kikai Kotei (Guangzhou) Co., Ltd. of China.

entries.5617839e25e6434d: The company manufactures and sells small blowers (cross-flow fans, axial fans, etc.) used as blower fans for indoor air-conditioning equipment and as cooling fans for machine tools and other equipment. Demand is rising for axial fans used in machine tools, industrial robots and semiconductor-related equipment.
entries.5d8f3004c26cf0ad: In the fiscal year ended December 2025, sales in the winding machine business increased significantly, as delivery of ｘＥＶ motor winding system projects that had carried over from the previous fiscal year was completed, large projects scheduled for the next fiscal year were delivered ahead of schedule, and consumables and spare parts also performed well. In October 2025, the new office building and large plant of a production subsidiary were completed and began operations.
entries.5e7734a40e15cc5d: The company manufactures and sells waterproof lighting fixtures used in bathrooms and products for residential and building ventilation. Bathroom lighting fixtures have been performing relatively steadily in apartment buildings.
entries.6a59e6649f7d0590: External sales for the fiscal year ended December 2025 were ¥13,583 million for the winding machine business and ¥4,655 million for the blower and housing-related equipment business. By region, sales to the United States were the largest at ¥10,637 million, and sales to Astemo Americas, Inc., its major customer, were ¥9,093 million, accounting for 49.9% of consolidated net sales. Consolidated employees number 425.
